parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I decide which drone flies along which way before signing off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I also want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, though I know software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
